question: Why can even a wise person be burned despite contact with nectar?
premises: Nectar and its essence are present
Even a wise person is affected
inference: Even the wise can be burned by the essence at the tip of nectar.
uncertainties: The yogic referent of amṛta+agraṃ is technically specific and context-dependent.
plain_english: Even a wise person can be burned by the essence at the tip of the nectar.
